text.card: A red giant 4,312 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 1.60 solar masses and 14.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,882 K at its surface.
